title: Top 10 largest Health Ministry contracts active in 2025
human_request: Top 10 largest contracts in Ministry of Health
notes: No period was specified, so this query uses contracts active in 2025. It ranks by contracts_data.volume, the total approved contract amount.
query: SELECT purpose, supplier_entity_name, purchasing_method, start_year, end_year, volume, executed, item_url FROM contracts_data WHERE purchasing_ministry = 'משרד הבריאות' AND start_year <= 2025 AND COALESCE(end_year, 9999) >= 2025 ORDER BY volume DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
